title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - AccessUsagePolicy
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/AccessUsagePolicy. An access or usage policy expressed using a DSL (e.g., Rego or ODRL) (access control, throttling, usage, retention, ...).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AccessUsagePolicy'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

policyLanguage.description: Property. The language in which the policy is expressed (e.g., ODRL, XACML, Rego, JSON-based policies). Controlled-vocabulary value (PolicyLanguageEnum), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

policyDocument.description: Property. A link to the actual policy or the content of the policy itself (xsd:anyURI or literal string).
